parsed.explanation: No trans criminalisation, facility ban, or documented border/document friction, so no tier-1 universal exposure. If outed, however, severity is driven by documented police abuse: a 2024 capital raid alleging assault/torture/sexual harassment of two LGBT people with no reported sanction, weak hate-crime enforcement (first conviction 2018), 20+ unsanctioned attacks closing an LGBT centre, and a 2025 report of significant intolerance/violence and rule-of-law weaknesses. Politicians' hate speech and custodial search-placement concerns add hostility, while recent Prides proceeded under heavy police protection. Recourse exists on paper but is shown to be largely ineffective, placing this in elevated risk.
